in_sanskrit.name: चतुरानन
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: The one who possesses complete or full knowledge and intelligence in the four fundamental aspects of life: physical, intellectual, emotional, and spiritual.

in_hindi.name: चतुरानन
in_hindi.long_meaning: The one who possesses complete or full knowledge in the four fundamental aspects of life: शरीरिक (physical), मनोवर्त (intellectual), स्वर्गिक (emotional), and आत्मावर्त (spiritual).

in_tamil.name: சதுரானன
in_tamil.long_meaning: The one who possesses complete or full knowledge in the four fundamental aspects of life: தோல்வின் (physical), ஜோல்வின் (intellectual), அவியர் (emotional), and அதிகர் (spiritual).

in_telugu.name: చతురానన
in_telugu.long_meaning: The one who possesses complete or full knowledge in the four fundamental aspects of life: శరీరమైప్పోయే (physical), మనోదేశ (intellectual), మృజేశ (emotional), and ఆత్మమైప్పోయే (spiritual).

in_marathi.name: Chaturaanan
in_marathi.long_meaning: Chaturaanan हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। A name derived from the Sanskrit word ‘chatura’ meaning ‘four’ and ‘anana’ meaning ‘armed’. This name refers to the four arms of various Hindu deities, symbolizing power, protection, and abundance.
